## [2.9.6](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/compare/v2.9.5...v2.9.6) (2026-11-13)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* add samsung editor lite non-one ui support; issue [#163](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/issues/163) ([994329d](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/commit/994329dd0636c7d2b07a2aa90757294c34c4e9f3))
* add samsung finder non-one ui support; issue [#158](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/issues/158) ([0ec3d29](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/commit/0ec3d29508af23067c264de8ddb5117c3c8170cd))
* gmail microg keeps getting notifications ([fc0790a](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/commit/fc0790acba055514f285e8fff0de1c5bfaf57861))
* samsung capture keeps its own screenshot settings and hides show taps; issue [#145](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/issues/145) ([e9d6c8a](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/commit/e9d6c8a1005215d9be89e540b03a42fccd7fd986))
* samsung capture opens on userdebug roms ([400935b](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/commit/400935b159076f028e718dc8e1f06bdd0ee666b4))
* samsung gallery edit opens a video editor; issue [#163](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/issues/163) ([9a57916](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/commit/9a579165052748fa24a933b52a8b675a33f052d1))
* samsung keyboard no longer crashes opening emoji and clipboard (input spy window); issue [#171](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/issues/171) ([c6b6256](https://github.com/bearinmindcat/morphe-patches/commit/c6b6256631b8245148e86da7d233859c6934552d))

patches.name: Enable non-ColorOS ROM support
patches.description: Makes OnePlus Documents installable and usable on non-ColorOS ROMs.

patches.description: Makes RedMagic Game Space usable on non-RedMagic ROMs.

patches.name: 2D / 3D compass
patches.description: Adds a 2D / 3D compass switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, tapping the compass in navigate mode switches the map between the tilted 3D view and a flat, north-up 2D map the way Google Maps' does, from any state (following you, panned away, paused), and brings the map back to you. The compass shows a single north arrow in 2D, and the next navigation starts in the mode you used last.

patches.name: Better filters
patches.description: Adds a Better filters switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, the trail filter's sliders move in finer steps over the same ranges: Rating in 0.1 stars (instead of Any, 3.5, 4 and 4.5), Length in 0.1 mi, Elevation gain in 10 ft, Highest point in 100 ft and Distance away in 1 mi (metric: 0.1 km, 5 m, 50 m, 1 km).

patches.name: Better tracking
patches.description: Adds a Better tracking switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, recordings work the way Gaia GPS records: the phone's GPS directly with every fix delivered live (no Play services batching), fixes worse than 65 m or physically impossible dropped, points kept 3 m apart, no trail-biased smoothing, and elevation converted to sea level and counted in 2 m steps.

patches.name: Black icon
patches.description: Uses a white AllTrails logo on black for the launcher icon and the splash screen, instead of green on dark green, so this build is easy to tell apart from the stock app.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs alongside stock AllTrails under its own package name.

options.description: The package name to install under. Must be a valid Android package name.

patches.name: Experimental screen
patches.description: Adds an Experimental row to your profile's menu, under Edit profile and Share profile, that opens an Experimental screen.

patches.name: Remember filters
patches.description: Adds a Remember filter states switch to the Experimental screen. With it on, the trail filters you set (length, elevation, rating, difficulty, activities, features and the rest, but not Distance away) stay set when you go back to the home screen and after the app restarts, instead of resetting.

patches.name: Theme
patches.description: Adds a Theme choice to the Experimental screen: Follow phone, Light, Dark or AMOLED black (dark with pure black backgrounds). AllTrails itself only follows the phone.

patches.name: 120 refresh rate
patches.description: Lifts the 60 Hz limit Maps puts on itself, on the app and on the map, so it can run at your screen's full refresh rate (such as 120 Hz). Uses more battery, most of all while navigating. Off by default: switch it on on the Customization screen.

patches.name: Account sheet cleanup
patches.description: Removes the "More from this app" label from the account sheet, and keeps the sheet open when you come back from Settings or Customization or tap "Your profile", instead of dropping back to the map.

patches.name: Add microG-RE support
patches.description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app that signs in to your Google account through microG-RE (MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore). Not for root installs; for original microG, use Add original microG support.

patches.name: Add original microG support
patches.description: Signs in through original microG on ROMs with signature spoofing. Keeps Maps' own package name; allow signature spoofing for it.

patches.name: Any media app
patches.description: Navigation's Default media app (Settings > Navigation) offers every music and podcast app that works with Android Auto, such as Poweramp, also where Google switches media controls off. YouTube Music and Spotify only connect to Google's own Maps.

patches.name: Avoid Flock cameras
patches.description: Steers driving directions around Flock cameras: when Google's route passes one, a camera-free way is worked out with BRouter, an OpenStreetMap router, and Maps asks Google again for a route through it, so Google still times and navigates the trip, and keeps it through reroutes. A detour longer than half again the distance is dropped. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, with Flock cameras; your route's start and end go to brouter.de. Trips with stops are left as they are.

patches.name: Better offline maps
patches.description: Reworks the offline area picker: zooming out really selects more instead of being shrunk to Google's size cap, the box can be resized by dragging its edges and corners, a large area is split into several downloads whose true total size is shown, and areas already downloaded are drawn on the map. Can be turned off on the Customization screen.

patches.name: Black theme
patches.description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.

patches.name: Blue pin
patches.description: Chromium-coloured flat map pin on every in-app product logo and the search bar's leading icon.

patches.name: Bypass Play Services checks
patches.description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing. Also skips Google's "isn't Play Protect certified" page, and with no Play services at all uses Android's own Cronet so the map still loads.

patches.name: Change app name
patches.description: Sets the launcher and in-app app name.

options.description: The name shown under the launcher icon and in the app switcher. Left at Ungoogled Maps, Add microG-RE support names the app microG Maps instead.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name. On by default, because stock Maps comes built into most phones and cannot be replaced by a patched copy.

options.description: The package name to install under. Must be a valid Android package name. Left at org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps, Add microG-RE support installs under org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg instead and Add original microG support keeps com.google.android.apps.maps.

patches.name: Customization screen
patches.description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.

patches.name: Flock cameras
patches.description: Puts Flock and other license plate reader cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap -- the cameras DeFlock's volunteers map -- and chimes and shows a note when one is coming up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the ones near you from an OpenStreetMap server, over the same area as the speed cameras.

patches.name: Follow playing media
patches.description: Navigation's media controls show what any app is playing (needs notification access).

patches.name: Hide ads and clutter
patches.description: Hides promoted map pins (on the map, in search results and along a route) and "Sponsored" search results, Gemini's AI summaries ("Know before you go" and the review summary), the row of businesses under an address on its place sheet, the home tab's Explore feed and the Explore / Contribute / You tabs. Each can be switched back on on the Customization screen.

patches.name: Legacy icon
patches.description: Uses the flat multicolour pin Maps had before the 2025 gradient icon as the launcher icon and on the screen Maps opens with. With Add microG-RE support, microG's C sits in the pin's circle.

patches.name: Location provider toggle
patches.description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG-RE's or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is never used, so location keeps working without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.

options.description: The location source Maps starts with. On: the fused provider -- Google Play services', or microG-RE's in microG Maps -- whenever it is installed and enabled, Android's own providers otherwise. Off: Android's own providers. Can be changed later on the Customization screen.

patches.name: Media panel can be closed
patches.description: Navigation's media button stays above the media controls, so they can be closed again.

patches.name: Offline saved places
patches.description: Save places without a Google account, kept only on the phone: Save opens Maps' own "Place saved" sheet (Want to go, Travel plans, Starred places, Favorites, your own lists, a note), and a "Local saved" row on the account sheet rebuilds Maps' You tab -- your recent places, your lists and labels (Home, Work, your own) -- with export and import (backup file, KML, Google Takeout's saved lists and Saved Places.json, several files or the whole Takeout .zip at once). It also has a Timeline: where the phone has been, grouped into days and visits, kept only on the phone, with GPX export. Recording is off until switched on there; it shows a notification while it runs. With Add microG-RE support, Maps' own Save keeps syncing to your account and Local saved instead copies the account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account).

patches.name: Power saving mode
patches.description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.

patches.name: Proxy
patches.description: Adds a Proxy screen to Customization that sends Maps' own traffic, map data included, through an HTTP proxy -- for example Orbot's (127.0.0.1:8118) to use Tor. Map data never falls back to a direct connection: if the proxy stops, Maps stops loading. Needs a recent Play services network engine (Cronet); Maps warns when it cannot take the proxy.

patches.name: Rectangle shapes
patches.description: Squares off rounded corners across the UI, including the two round navigation buttons.

patches.name: Remove permissions
patches.description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG-RE support, whose account features need them.

patches.name: Remove sign-in prompts
patches.description: Removes Google's sign-in prompts: the first-launch "Make it your map" page, the search screen's "Tired of typing?" card and the account sheet's "Sign in" pill. Tapping "Your profile" (or the pill, where it still shows) answers with a "Can't sign in" toast instead of nothing. With Add microG-RE support, which signs in, only the first-launch page and the card go.

patches.name: Remove telemetry
patches.description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services. With Add microG-RE support, Firebase Installations and Location History are left alone, so Timeline, account sync and push messages keep working.

patches.name: Review counts in navigation search
patches.description: Places found while navigating show their review count next to the rating.

patches.name: Speed cameras
patches.description: Chimes and shows a note when a speed or red light camera is coming up ahead, and puts the cameras on the map, from OpenStreetMap. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet, because it downloads the cameras near you from an OpenStreetMap server -- an area you choose there, about 25 to 175 km across.

patches.name: Speeding chime
patches.description: Plays a chime when your speed passes the speed limit during navigation, as Waze does. Maps itself only turns its speedometer red. When it chimes is chosen in Waze & external data source, a row on the account sheet.

patches.name: Trim account menu
patches.description: Removes Your Timeline, Location sharing, Your data in Maps and Help & feedback from the account sheet. Left out with Add microG-RE support, whose account features need them.

patches.name: Waze alerts
patches.description: Shows the alerts a Waze on the same phone is tracking -- police to begin with, and any of crashes, hazards, traffic jams, closures and speed cameras -- as pins on the map, with a chime and a note as one comes up ahead. Off until turned on in Waze & external data source. Waze has to be patched with Share alerts with Maps, signed in and open; in the background is enough.
